section.title: About This Reference
section.p: The Git Client add-on provides actions in the Git menu, the Git Client views, contextual menus, and preferences pages. The action category topics that follow define each action once, list the main places where it is available, and include notes or best practices when they are useful.
No default keyboard shortcuts are documented for these actions. If an action has a shortcut in a future version, add it to the corresponding action entry.
